headline: Paraguay Seeks to Conclude Itaipú Energy Negotiations with Brazil by Year-End
summary: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña stated that negotiations with Brazil regarding the Itaipú hydroelectric dam treaty and Annex C review are well-positioned for completion before the end of the year.
why: Itaipú is one of the world's largest hydroelectric power plants jointly operated by Brazil and Paraguay, making power pricing and treaty terms vital for both nations' energy sectors.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: Bilateral agreements on hydroelectric energy allocation and tariffs directly impact national energy revenues and costs.
